title: Verified schedule switching for crosstalk identification in quantum error correction
description: Open-source implementation of verified schedule switching: syndrome-extraction units that share gates and gate order but differ in which operations overlap are verified against a declared set of crosstalk couplings, and switching between them identifies concurrency-induced ZZ couplings from detector statistics, monitors the observation model, and selects the unit used for protection. Includes the Stim-based compiler and noise model, fault-distance verification, the exact parity observation model, identification, finite-sample tests, residual monitoring, a protection-under-drift experiment with PyMatching, all result files and figure scripts.
